```artifact
Feature: Access Control and User-Doctor-Patient Mapping
  As a system user
    Given I have a login with a valid User-ID and Password
    And I attempt to access the system
    Then I should be granted access if my User-ID is within the specified PinCodes (Zones)

Scenario: Access granted for valid User-ID within specified PinCodes
  @precondition { "User-ID is within the specified PinCodes (Zones)" }
  @kind: positive
  When: I access the system with a valid User-ID and Password
  Then I should be granted access

Scenario: Access denied for invalid User-ID outside specified PinCodes
  @precondition { "User-ID is outside the specified PinCodes (Zones)" }
  And I attempt to access the system with an invalid User-ID
  Then I should be denied access

Scenario: Secure Management of Login-ID/Password
  Given Users must access the system using a login-id and password
  And the login-id/password must be managed in a secured manner
  When: I attempt to access the system with a secure login-id/password
  Then I should gain access

  And I attempt to access the system with an insecure login-id/password
  Then I should be denied access

Scenario: Speciality to Doctor Mapping
  Given Each Speciality 'has' one or more Doctors linked to it
  And I query a Speciality
  Then I should retrieve the linked Doctors

Scenario: Doctor to Speciality Mapping
  Given Each Doctor 'has' one Speciality
  And I query a Doctor
  Then I should retrieve the corresponding Speciality

Scenario: Patient Registration
  Given I am a new Patient
  And I fill out the Patient profile
  When I submit the Patient profile
  Then I should receive a unique Patient ID

Scenario: Patient Consultation Request
  Given I am a registered Patient
  And I request a consultation
  When I submit the request
  Then I should receive a confirmation of the request

Scenario: Doctor to Patient Consultation Request
  Given I am a Doctor
  And I have Patients registered under my Speciality
  And I submit a consultation request
  Then I should receive confirmation of the request

Scenario: Multiple Consultations for a Patient
  Given I am a Patient with multiple Patients registered
  And I request a consultation for each Patient
  When I submit the requests
  Then I should receive confirmation for each request

Scenario Outline: Doctor to Speciality Mapping with Boundary Values
  Given Each Doctor 'has' one Speciality
  And I query a Doctor
  When I query a Doctor with a boundary Speciality value
  Then I should retrieve the corresponding Speciality

  Example:
  | Speciality value | Expected Speciality |
  | "Cardiology"       | "Cardiology"        |
  | "Invalid Value"     | Exception thrown  |

Scenario Outline: Multiple Consultations for a Patient with Boundary Values
  Given I am a Patient with multiple Patients registered
  And I request a consultation for each Patient
  When I submit requests with boundary Speciality values
  Then I should receive confirmation for each request or an exception thrown

  Example:
  | Speciality value | Expected Speciality |
  | "Cardiology"       | "Cardiology"        |
  | "Invalid Value"     | Exception thrown  |

Scenario Outline: Patient Registration with Boundary Values
  Given I am a new Patient
  And I fill out the Patient profile with boundary data
  When I submit the Patient profile
  Then I should receive a unique Patient ID or an exception thrown

  Example:
  | Boundary data | Expected Patient ID |
  | "Valid"       | "Generated ID"    |
  | "Invalid"     | Exception thrown  |

Scenario Outline: Multiple Consultations for a Patient with Boundary Values
  Given I am a Patient with multiple Patients registered
  And I request a consultation for each Patient with boundary data
  When I submit requests with boundary data
  Then I should receive confirmation for each request or an exception thrown

  Example:
  | Boundary data | Expected confirmation |
  | "Valid"       | "Confirmation"     |
  | "Invalid"     | Exception thrown  |
```
